# vyos.blueprints.ospf_unnumbered

OSPF unnumbered with ECMP (docs blueprint "OSPF unnumbered with ECMP")

- Puts the router-id as a /32 on the loopback and on every listed link, runs OSPF point-to-point over those links and redistributes connected routes. Parallel links to the same neighbour give ECMP.
- Works for any number of routers; each router lists only its own links.
- LAN addressing (`eth0` on the docs page) belongs to `vyos.blueprints.base`.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.ospf_unnumbered
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ospf_unnumbered_router_id` | str | yes |  | OSPF router-id; also used as the /32 address on `lo` and on each link. |
| `ospf_unnumbered_interfaces` | list | yes |  | Unnumbered point-to-point links, e.g. `[eth1, eth2]`. |
| `ospf_unnumbered_area` | str |  | `0.0.0.0` | OSPF area. |
| `ospf_unnumbered_md5_key` | str |  | `''` | MD5 key for OSPF authentication. Empty disables authentication. |
| `ospf_unnumbered_md5_key_id` | int |  | `1` | MD5 key id. |
| `ospf_unnumbered_redistribute` | list |  | `[connected]` | Route types redistributed into OSPF. |
| `ospf_unnumbered_group` | str |  | `''` | Inventory group of all routers in the fabric; used only by `verify`. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify` against all routers in the same play. Checks one Full adjacency per listed link and, with `ospf_unnumbered_group`, an OSPF route to every other router-id. When the group has exactly two routers, also checks one ECMP next hop per link.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ospf_unnumbered_router_id` | str | yes |  | Same value as for `main`. |
| `ospf_unnumbered_interfaces` | list | yes |  | Same value as for `main`. |
| `ospf_unnumbered_group` | str |  | `''` | Same value as for `main`. |
